findings: Read independently first. One NED (Wu Yufeng, appointed Dec 2024); the earlier NED Guo Yongqi resigned Dec 2024 (pdf p353 only) and is not on the Listing board. Link: Wu is managing partner of Hainan Shiyu; Shiyu is stated to manage shareholder Suzhou Yongyu (pdf p135 note 1; Yongyu's GP Xizang Shiyu is wholly owned by Shiyu). The two mentions use the identical full company name, so this is an explicit textual link, not a same-name inference. Verified all candidate quotes verbatim and page mapping. Changes: dropped pdf p83 waiver quote (it is a waiver condition on H-share-placee minority shareholders, not evidence about Yongyu or Wu; candidate's use of it is an over-read) and the pdf p138 table-row and p240 composition quotes (redundant; composition fact in interpretation). Candidate's statement that Yongyu is 'absent from LPD-period disclosures' is only true in the sense that the LPD-period substantial-shareholder table (pdf p261) lists just the controlling group; the shareholder tables at pdf p134-139 are as of 2020 and Jan 2022.
residual_uncertainty: Prospectus does not say Yongyu/Shiyu nominated Wu Yufeng; does not state whether Suzhou Yongyu still holds shares at the Latest Practicable Date; does not state which of the Dec 2019/Mar 2020 rounds Yongyu joined (both pre-IPO). Value 1 rests on Wu being a principal of the fund manager of an identified pre-IPO investor. Moderate confidence.
